canonical_example.text: De que adianta?
canonical_example.translation: What use is that?

meanings.translation: to work, function, to have a point

examples.text: De que adianta?
examples.translation: What use is that?
examples.english: What use is that?

examples.text: Crispiniano quis virar valente. Que é que adiantava? Fifi reteve com dificuldade umas lágrimas sinceras.
examples.ref: 1928, Antônio de Alcântara Machado, O Mártir Jesus, Laranja-da-China:
examples.english: Crispiniano wanted to become valiant. What was the point? Fifi retained with difficulty some sincere tears.
examples.translation: Crispiniano wanted to become valiant. What was the point? Fifi retained with difficulty some sincere tears.

examples.text: Subornar também não adianta. Quer dizer: é impossível. Melhor é revelar o segredo.
examples.ref: 1961, Antônio de Alcântara Machado, As Cinco Panelas de Ouro, Contos Avulsos:
examples.english: Bribing also doesn't work. I mean: it is impossible. It is better to reveal the secret.
examples.translation: Bribing also doesn't work. I mean: it is impossible. It is better to reveal the secret.
